jobs.title: Market Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
Summary of Position
The Market Strategy Analyst is responsible for developing and incorporating advanced spatial and quantitative analytics into Dollar Tree's real estate planning, market optimization, and new store site selection processes. The role supports strategic growth initiatives through market planning, sales forecasting, site evaluation, cannibalization analysis, and predictive modeling.
The Market Strategy Analyst will develop, enhance, and maintain the Enterprise's Market Optimization and Sales Forecasting Systems used to identify optimal growth opportunities, forecast sales performance, evaluate market potential, and support real estate decision-making. The analyst will leverage demographic, consumer, competitive, mobility, and store performance data to provide actionable recommendations that improve store placement, network optimization, and business performance.

1. Market Optimization and Growth Strategy
Develop and support market optimization processes to identify optimal locations for new store growth through the development of market planning strategies.
- Work closely with Real Estate, Operations, Asset Protection, Finance, and Senior Leadership to determine the optimal deployment of stores by banner.
- Evaluate market opportunities, whitespace opportunities, relocation candidates, and market saturation levels.
- Support strategic growth initiatives through trade area and market analyses.

2. Site Selection and Sales Forecasting
Develop and manage analytical, forecasting, and decision-support processes for Real Estate and Finance.
- Incorporate spatial analytics and location intelligence into site selection processes.
- Produce sales forecasts for proposed locations using statistical, geographic, and operational factors.
- Assess market risks and opportunities impacting store performance.

3. Cannibalization and Network Analytics
Identify and understand significant drivers of store sales and forecast impacts to existing stores.
- Develop and enhance cannibalization and transfer-sales models.
- Conduct analog store selection and comparison analyses.
- Evaluate the effects of store openings, closings, relocations, and competitor activity on network performance.

4. Advanced Analytics and Predictive Modeling
Support the continual enhancement of forecasting and market planning methodologies.
- Develop, evaluate, and improve predictive and statistical models.
- Apply machine learning, regression, and other quantitative techniques where appropriate.
- Monitor model performance and identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy.

5. Data Acquisition and Process Improvement
Identify opportunities for improved data sources, analytical methodologies, and process enhancements.
- Evaluate emerging datasets and analytical techniques to improve business outcomes.
- Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.

6. Data Management and Integration
Source new data and partner with internal and external stakeholders to access relevant and timely information.
- Integrate demographic, mobility, consumer, competitive, and retail datasets into analytical workflows.
- Ensure data quality and consistency across forecasting and market planning initiatives.
- Support ongoing enhancement of enterprise data assets.

7. Analytical Solutions Development
Build, implement, document, maintain, and improve models, scripts, and workflows.
- Develop scalable analytical solutions using SQL, Alteryx, ArcGIS, Excel, and other analytical platforms.
- Automate recurring processes and reporting activities.
- Maintain production-ready analytical workflows and supporting documentation.

8. Reporting and Visualization
Develop reporting tools and executive-level presentations that communicate complex analyses to business stakeholders.
- Build dashboards and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making.
- Present findings and recommendations to Real Estate leadership, Finance, and Senior Management.

9. Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with GIS, Data, Finance, and Real Estate teams to leverage enterprise data and analytical capabilities.
- Provide guidance on new analytical approaches and data integration opportunities.
- Support enterprise initiatives involving multi-banner real estate analytics.

10. Ad Hoc Analysis and Strategic Support
Prepare ad hoc analyses, mapping requests, executive presentations, and strategic recommendations.
- Respond to business questions with timely and accurate analyses.
- Support special projects and strategic initiatives as needed.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Geography, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Analytics, or another quantitative discipline.
- 3-5 years of experience in real estate analytics, site selection, market planning, forecasting, GIS, retail analytics, or a related field.
- Experience with site selection, trade area analysis, market planning, and location intelligence methodologies.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and SQL.
- Experience with data analysis and visualization tools.
- Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative reasoning skills.
- High level of initiative and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Desired Qualifications
- Master's degree in Finance, Business, Geography, Statistics, Data Science, Analytics, or another quantitative discipline.
- Experience in retail site selection, location strategy, or network planning.
- Experience with ArcGIS Pro, Business Analyst, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
- Experience with advanced statistical modeling techniques and predictive analytics with machine learning applications.

Start Rate = $78,000 to $92,500 based on experience plus 10% bonus. The company offers Health, Dental, & Vision, a flexible spending account, life and disability insurance benefits, a 401k plan, PTO, paid holidays annually, and an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
General Summary
The Warehouse Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing all distribution center operations, including receiving, reserve storage, replenishment, order selection, loading, shipping, and outbound documentation processes. This role ensures production, service, and operational goals are achieved through effective workforce planning, scheduling, and resource management. The manager develops, implements, and evaluates procedures that support the efficient flow of merchandise across inbound and outbound operations while maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, safety, and productivity. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Warehouse Operations Manager exercises sound judgment in establishing priorities, determining objectives, and implementing solutions to complex operational challenges. Assignments are often self-directed, with performance measured by the achievement of organizational goals, operational efficiency, and adherence to schedules. This position champions Dollar Tree’s store-focused culture by delivering exceptional service to internal customers and supporting the company’s values, commitment to customer satisfaction, sales growth, and operational excellence.

An Operations Manager at Dollar Tree is responsible for:
• Managing the development, implementation, and administration of operational policies, programs, and systems within functional areas.
• Establish methods and procedures for departmental work activities; identify and resolve operational problems; and communicate expertise and approvals concerning departmental activities.
• Monitor, assess, manage, and make recommendations to key productivity indicators, such as financial, productivity, service, and people goals in order to reduce and control costs.
• Ensure accuracy, housekeeping, merchandise damage minimization, and safety through monitoring and enforcement of company requirements.
• Manage and coordinate the receipt of merchandise include the unloading and checking of merchandise. Monitor loads to ensure merchandise in unloaded according to priority designation.
• Coordinate and manage the flow of reserve inventory from receiving dock to reserve locations. Monitor reserve areas to ensure the orderly storage of merchandise.
• Coordinate and manage replenishments cycles of the operation to assure the timely restocking of primary pick locations.
• Establish and monitor the daily receiving schedule and prioritize ensuring priorities are adhered to and resources are utilized properly to control cost in order to meet market demands.
• Coordinate and manage the filling of store orders, including the selection of orders, merge operations, loading of trailers and all related paperwork. Monitor loads to ensure merchandise is loaded according to quality standards.
• Coordinate and manage the flow of all order selection functions from primary pick locations to final close of outbound loaded trailers. Monitor load quality to assure load stability on outbound deliveries.
• Assist in the coordination and managing of the replenishment cycles of the operation to assure the timely restocking of primary pick locations.
• Establish and monitor the daily selecting and loading schedule and ensure schedules are adhered to and resources are utilized properly to control cost in order to meet market demands.
• Hire, orient, train, evaluate, and develop associates.
• Carry out disciplinary actions or recommend termination of employment as appropriate.
• Share and provide appropriate information and anticipate information needs of all distribution center associates.
• Prepare various statistics and reports for functional areas.

Position Requirements:
• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration or logistics preferred.
• Minimum of four years distribution center management, operations experience or equivalent.
• Good working knowledge of distribution center practices and procedures.
• Strong leadership, administrative, organizational, managerial and communication skills.
• Strong analytical ability to gather and interpret information and develop, recommend, and implement solutions.
• Strong leadership, administrative, organizational, managerial, interpersonal, and communication skills; Ability to lead by example, mentor, develop, and foster a team environment are essential.
• Strong ability to lead/coach associates towards professional success
• Requires rapid and thorough independent decision making and creative problem-solving skills, good judgment as well as the ability to accept personal and departmental accountability for areas of responsibility.
• PC skills – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access. Working knowledge of WMS System
• Must be able to continuously walk the Distribution Center floor for an extended period of time
• Must be able to lift or move 60 lbs. (may be more frequent during cycle counts or physical inventories)
• Must be able to work flexible hours and shifts
• Less than 10% overnight travel Desired Qualifications - Desired but not required. Bilingual (Spanish)

Computer Skills : Software: Microsoft Office Application proficiency, WMS, Retek, Radio Frequency (RF), Manhattan, AS400 or Catalyst.
